Subject: Unexpected 503/latency spike - Jul 19 14:05-14:25 UTC (impacting checkout)

Hi Connor / Marissa —

We observed a sustained spike of 503s and elevated latency on our Redwood-backed checkout route between roughly 14:05 and 14:25 UTC today. Our telemetry shows a ~15% failure rate and a spike in tail latencies that caused several customer transactions to time out. This maps to several high-severity errors in our payment flow and caused retries / doubled charges for a handful of orders.

We've attached a small trace snippet and timings (buyfast-trace-snippet.txt) to help with triage. Can you confirm if this window qualifies for remediation under our SLA and if Redwood will provide the proportional remedy outlined in section 5.2 of the contract? We also need an accelerated post-incident review — our legal and ops teams are asking for an RCA and evidence bundle for their internal audit.

Requested deliverables:
- Formal confirmation of impacted window and eligibility for SLA remedy
- Raw logs/traces for 14:00–14:30 UTC (or a download link)
- Timeline for RCA / postmortem and expected publication date

Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,
Emma Schultz
Head of Payments Operations
BuyFast

Subject: Re: Incident triage - Jul 19 14:05–14:25 UTC — infra findings and evidence links

Folks — quick infra summary from initial triage:

What we see
- Between 14:04:50 and 14:24:38 UTC there was an increased rate of preemptions on a subset of nodes in the us-west-2 dedicated pool that serves BuyFast's shard. A rolling autoscaler reaction overlapped with a transient KVM scheduler contention event.
- The combination caused KV cache misses and tokenization stalls which manifested as 503s at the service edge and elevated token generation tail latency. Error rates peaked ~14:11–14:14 UTC.

Artifacts gathered
- Aggregated service traces (raw-traces-20260719.zip) uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-incident-archives/DEAL-7893/20260719/raw-traces-20260719.zip
- Kernel scheduler counters and node eviction logs (linked in the Drive RCA draft below)

Preliminary impact window
- Candidate window for SLA evaluation: 2026-07-19T14:04:50Z — 2026-07-19T14:24:38Z. We recommend using the conservative start time of 14:05:00 and end time of 14:24:00 for external communications to match BuyFast observations.

Next steps / asks
- Connor / Marissa: confirm the candidate window with BuyFast and whether they want the proportional remedy calculation per contract 5.2.
- Neha / Laura: please review the customer contract clause for remedies; if there's any reason to treat this as an exception (maintenance, customer root cause), flag immediately.
- Internal: I will open a PSP ticket to capture node eviction metrics and provide a final node-level timeline by tomorrow EOD.

Attachments / links: raw-traces-20260719.zip (s3 path), proposed-rca-draft.md (https://drive.redwood.internal/rca/DEAL-7893-20260719)

Aditya Rao
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Validated window and eligibility
- Validated impact window: 2026-07-19T14:05:00Z — 2026-07-19T14:24:00Z (matches your observed timings).
- Eligibility: This incident is infrastructure-side (node preemptions + scheduler contention). Per section 5.2 of the signed SLA, BuyFast is eligible for a proportional availability remedy.

Remedy calculation
- As a next step we'll prepare a proportional credit calculation based on the percent of downtime within the billing period and the contract formula. Expect the preliminary credit amount in the next 48 hours.

RCA timeline and evidence bundle
- We've uploaded the raw traces and node logs to a secure archive (raw-traces-20260719.zip) and started a draft RCA (proposed-rca-draft.md). Internal engineers will finalize the timeline and contributing factors by EOD tomorrow; public-facing RCA will be shared within 72 hours. Link: https://drive.redwood.internal/rca/DEAL-7893-20260719

Ask from BuyFast
- Please confirm whether you want us to proceed with the proposed proportional credit calculation and whether we should initiate an expedited public RCA for your audit team.

If you'd like a call to review numbers once the credit calc is ready, Connor and I are available this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
